summary:
The 98 in-scope files (74 tests/*.py, tests/README.md, 13 SDBASE tools, 10 otomasyon_testleri files) break down as: 38 as is, 42 small edits, 16 partial rewrites, 2 excluded with replacement. For tests/*.py alone: runners+fixture 9/14/10/1, test_*.py 22/13/5/0; SDBASE tools 3/9/1/0; otomasyon 4/5/0/1 (build.sh becomes a CMake target).

The backend tests (test_desktop_*, playlist/playout/schema tests) run SDBASE in-process and are mostly portable once the SDBASE and tools shims exist. The Linux-specific code sits in the fixture runners:
- **Audio:** pactl null sinks, parec captures, private pulseaudio/PipeWire daemons (setsid, flatpak-spawn, /proc/<pid>/fd socket aliases, fake D-Bus), pacat players.
- **Display:** Xvfb -displayfd with select() on pipes, pass_fds, a private dbus-daemon, resource.setrlimit, and GDK_BACKEND=x11.
- **Processes:** SIGTERM/SIGINT/SIGKILL, /proc cmdline scans, /proc/<pid>/exe, pidfd, fcntl.flock probes.
- **Files:** 0600/0700 mode assertions, chmod 0644 "public" credentials, symlinks, os.mkfifo, encoding-less text I/O, os.open without O_BINARY.
- **Release/packaging:** run-radios.sh, ELF/glibc checks, flatpak SDK.

Several hidden traps would silently break "portable" code:
- `.name != "test_audio_ui"` checks fail against the `.exe` name, which disables per-case isolation.
- Backslash paths written into radios.ini are rejected by GKeyFile as invalid escapes.
- POSIX path literals are rejected by Windows-rule validators.
- A killed process returns 1, not a negative code.
- urllib picks up the registry proxy even for 127.0.0.1.
- SDBASE's inherited SO_REUSEADDR lets a second socket hijack a port, which defeats the foreign-listener tests.

The recommended design, Windows-only per D1:
- Keep every runner-to-C-exe contract: argv/cwd, RADIOS_TEST_* names, gate files and anchors, proof files, TAP validation, exit code 77.
- Keep the module-level copytree/subprocess.run seams that the derived runners monkeypatch.
- Add tests/radios_testkit.py and tests/pcm_analysis.py on top of the canonical sdbase/_platform.py. They cover:
  - environment and preflight
  - private SDBASE installation (copying the tools shim, forward-slash python_command)
  - newline-agnostic gate injection
  - GLib case runner
  - kill-on-close Job Object
  - graceful stop via Local\RadioS-stop-<pid>, WM_CLOSE and end-session
  - LockFileEx probes
  - ACL privacy assertions
  - junction/symlink helpers
  - retrying cleanup
- Audio uses the audio area's in-process null provider. Its virtual sinks write the same real-time float32 capture files parec produced, with silence while idle, plus .monitor sources, tone applications and a running switch. Real WASAPI loopback becomes an opt-in `real-audio` label.
- GUI runs on a private Win32 desktop behind an interactive-session check that exits 77.
- Python runs as runtime\python\python.exe -X utf8 -B; children use -E -s -B -X utf8; byte-relevant writes use utf-8 with LF.

Acceptance assertions change where Linux-only observations disappear (parec independence, pactl sink-input/source-output checks, signal exit semantics, ELF). Each change is mapped in a table in the spec.
files_touched: tests/run_audio_ui.py (R: null audio fixture, preflight, .stem fix, job/GUI env)
tests/run_audio_routing.py (R: keep helpers as re-export, delete main)
tests/run_audio_soak.py (R: null sink s16le capture, drop SIGTERM handler)
tests/run_routing_graph_ui.py (R: fixture sinks/applications, native input, no Pulse/X11)
tests/run_broadcast_ui.py (S: join handler threads before cleanup)
tests/test_application_shutdown.py (R: stop event/WM_CLOSE/end-session, shim lock, null audio)
tests/test_packaging.py (R: windows kind PE/zip cases, junction variants)
tests/test_storage_locations.py (R: Windows storage path rules, GKeyFile escaping)
tools/otomasyon_testleri/build.sh (X: replaced by CMake target otomasyon_e2e)
CMakeLists.txt + cmake/*.cmake test registrations (build area: interpreter, ENVIRONMENT, PYTHONPATH, WORKING_DIRECTORY, labels)
key_decisions: Keep every runner<->C-exe contract byte-for-byte: argv/cwd, RADIOS_TEST_* env names, gate anchors/flag files in store.root, proof/marker files, TAP plan/outcome validation, exit code 77; only fixture mechanics change.

Preserve the monkeypatch seams: base runners (run_audio_ui/run_data_ui/run_admin_ui) keep module-level shutil.copytree(PROJECT/'database/SDBASE/src', ...) and subprocess.run(command + ['init', ...]) calls so 7 derived runners stay unchanged.
New tests/radios_testkit.py (+ pcm_analysis.py, radios_audio_fixture.py) built on the canonical sdbase/_platform.py loaded by file path; tests never re-implement lock offsets, SDDL or event names.

Interpreter: <root>\runtime\python\python.exe -X utf8 -B for all tests (D7); Python children via python_child_argv (-E -s -B -X utf8); PYTHONPATH-based '-c' children rewritten to insert sys.path from argv.

radios.ini path values written with forward slashes (Path(sys.executable).as_posix()) because GKeyFile rejects '\m','\U' escapes; storage.ini values written GKeyFile-escaped (backslash form required by the storage path rule).
Every runner adopts a kill-on-close Job Object (KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE|DIE_ON_UNHANDLED_EXCEPTION, no BREAKAWAY_OK) plus SetErrorMode; /proc scans become stop CLI + iter_processes + TerminateProcess.

Graceful stop = request_stop(pid) on Local\RadioS-stop-<pid> (D6); GUI shutdown test uses stop event, WM_CLOSE and WM_QUERYENDSESSION/WM_ENDSESSION instead of SIGTERM/SIGINT; lock-release assertions poll up to 2 s.

Audio: in-process null provider (audio-backend.md 5.9) selected by one env var (recommend RADIOS_AUDIO_SERVER=null:<json>) whose sinks write real-time f32le/s16le capture files incl. silence, with <sink>.monitor, tone 'applications' (pid-based) and a running toggle; real WASAPI loopback only as opt-in 'real-audio' label on an inaudible endpoint.

GUI: private Win32 desktop (tests-c 6.3), preferably switched in-process via RADIOS_TEST_PRIVATE_DESKTOP=1 so runner argv seams stay; interactive window-station check returns 77; GSETTINGS_BACKEND=memory, private XDG dirs, no GDK_BACKEND=x11.
Privacy assertions use is_private/owned_by_current_user (core spec 5.2 SDDL); fixture-created files the product validates are created private via the shim (Desktop ACL leaks CodexSandboxUsers ACE).
Links: file symlinks via symlink_or_skip; every directory-link case gets an unprivileged junction variant; FIFO cases replaced by directory-named-file and reserved-name cases.

Delete per D1: run_routing_host.py (replaced by opt-in run_wasapi_acceptance.py), run_audio_routing.main, PipeWire/flatpak branches, test_radios_launch.SdkSandbox, run_release_acceptance --host-runtime, otomasyon build.sh (-> CMake target otomasyon_e2e); the no-DISPLAY release test moves to a C unit test.
Register the 13 SDBASE acceptance tools under CTest label 'sdbase-acceptance' as the regression net for Windows replace/lock/crash semantics.
risks: Null-provider captures are produced inside the process under test (no independent parec); a backend bug writing identical wrong bytes to device and capture is invisible without the opt-in WASAPI loopback run.

Per-case fresh installations (native_playout ~38 targets, native_dj 18 cases) copy assets+SDBASE each time; Defender scanning and no-bytecode imports can make Windows 2-5x slower and hit CTest timeouts.
GUI suites need an interactive unlocked session; service-hosted CI would report 77 everywhere (silent coverage loss) unless CI asserts the windows-gui label ran.

Sharing violations: C deleting gate files while the Python gate reads them, TemporaryDirectory cleanup with lingering handles/threads, os.replace of JSON read concurrently (acceptance.py) -> flakes without retry budgets.
Symlink coverage depends on Developer Mode/privilege; file-symlink cases may skip on CI (junction variants keep directory coverage).
If SDBASE keeps SO_REUSEADDR on Windows, foreign-listener tests pass wrongly or flap (port hijack).
Windows RST on close-with-unread-data can turn expected EOF into ConnectionResetError in raw-socket checks (engine_acceptance).
Routing semantics differ (Windows never moves apps; process loopback needs build >= 20348); some Linux assertions move to C or become opt-in.
G_DEBUG=fatal-warnings aborts on Windows-only GTK warnings (missing loaders.cache/schemas/hicolor, custom selection atoms) unless the runtime self-check passes first.
Deep fixture paths (data\recovery\<uuid>\<uuid>\..., RadioS.sdb.objects\ab\<sha256>) under Desktop\RadioS\build approach MAX_PATH; 8.3 %TEMP% paths break string comparisons unless resolved.

Sibling specs conflict on the audio test-host env var/JSON, lock byte offset (0x4000000000000000 vs 0x7FFFFFFF00000000) and stop-event names; drift silently disables lock interop or graceful stop until the contract test catches it.
Windows registry proxy affects urllib loopback calls unless a no-proxy opener is used.
cross_area_dependencies: SDBASE engine/app: sdbase/_platform.py with lock(), is_private/owned_by_current_user/make_private/mkdir_private/open_fd(private), is_link, replace/rename_noreplace/link_noreplace/unlink/rmtree_quietly, python_child_argv/env, process_identity, request_stop/StopRequest, path helpers, canonical_timezone; loadable standalone by file path.

SDBASE: keep http_server.py gate anchors byte-identical with LF ('                result = self._dispatch(method, path, query, principal)\n' once, '    limits = RequestLimiter()\n' once, 'capacity=120, refill_per_second=10' twice) and names StoreError/WriteRejected in scope; BoundedHTTPServer.allow_reuse_address=False on Windows; Windows absolute-path rules in desktop_media provenance, desktop_transfer_package destination/media_root, rekordbox_device usb_root, desktop_api recorder folder; no persistent file handles.

Tools: tools shim (iter_processes with argv, no_proxy_opener, configure_stdio_utf8, python_argv), radios_database.py JSON contract unchanged (init/start/status/check/stop), stop via D6 event, spawn retry without CREATE_BREAKAWAY_FROM_JOB inside a job, sibling imports without relying on PYTHONPATH, GKeyFile-compatible unescape of INI values (reject invalid escapes), TOOLS_RUNTIME_FILES list so fixtures copy the shim, Windows launcher (RadioS.exe ensure) and packaging 'windows' zip kind with verify/collect APIs.

Audio engine/routing: null provider per audio-backend.md 5.9 (silence-while-idle capture files, f32le/s16le, .monitor loopback, 44.1 kHz sinks, running toggle, add/remove sinks) extended with pid-based tone applications (audio-routing-capture 12.1); single selector env var decided by the lead; RADIOS_TEST_PULSE_SERVER -> RADIOS_TEST_AUDIO_SERVER.

C tests (tests-c): private desktop delivery (prefer in-process SetThreadDesktop via RADIOS_TEST_PRIVATE_DESKTOP=1, else launcher exe), posted-input/SendInput backends, test runtime TU (manifest UTF-8 argv, binary _fmode, WerSetFlags/_set_abort_behavior, timeBeginPeriod), routing tests reading pid/sink-name env values, test_audio_recovery driven in-process, pread replacements in capture readers, retrying unlink of gate files.

UI/platform C: GUI creates Local\RadioS-stop-<pid> and exits 0 on it, on WM_CLOSE and on WM_ENDSESSION after finalizing WAVs; gui.lock LOCK_SH on byte 0x4000000000000000, non-inheritable; passive CLI modes write to inherited std handles; interactive-session check unit-tested in C.

Build/CMake: Python3_EXECUTABLE = runtime\python\python.exe with -X utf8 -B in every add_test; remove GDK_BACKEND=x11 on WIN32; add PYTHONUTF8/PYTHONIOENCODING/GSETTINGS_BACKEND=memory; PATH prepend of ucrt64\bin via ENVIRONMENT_MODIFICATION; fix ':'-joined PYTHONPATH (desktop_autodj, desktop_playout_vocal_cues); WORKING_DIRECTORY /tmp -> build dir; otomasyon_e2e target + --driver; labels real-audio/windows-gui/sdbase-acceptance; RESOURCE_LOCK native_input/system_clipboard; manifest on every test exe; .gitattributes LF.
Runtime packaging: runtime\python 3.14.8 with tzdata and no ._pth (already staged), MSYS2 ffmpeg.exe/ffprobe.exe/openssl.exe available to tests.
platform_api_needs: Python sdbase/_platform.py: lock(fd: int, *, shared: bool = False, blocking: bool = True) -> None / unlock(fd) -> None — LockFileEx/UnlockFileEx on 1 byte at offset 0x4000000000000000 (OVERLAPPED.OffsetHigh=0x40000000); non-blocking contention raises BlockingIOError(EWOULDBLOCK); works on read-only handles.

Python: is_private(path_or_fd) -> bool and owned_by_current_user(path_or_fd) -> bool — core-posix-files.md 5.2 rule (DACL present; allow ACEs only for user/owner/SYSTEM/Administrators/OWNER RIGHTS unless harmless mask; FAT/exFAT fail closed).

Python: make_private(path_or_fd) -> None, mkdir_private(path, *, parents=False, exist_ok=False) -> None, open_fd(path, flags, *, nofollow=False, private=False, share_delete=True) -> int (always O_BINARY|O_NOINHERIT; private=True applies file SDDL O:<SID>D:P(A;;FA;;;<SID>)(A;;FA;;;SY)(A;;FA;;;BA)).

Python test helper (shim or testkit): make_public_for_tests(path) -> None — merge an allow FILE_GENERIC_READ ACE for S-1-5-32-545 (Users) via SetEntriesInAclW + SetNamedSecurityInfoW so is_private() becomes False.
Python: is_link(path) -> bool / stat_is_link(st) -> bool — True for symlinks and name-surrogate reparse points (junctions).

Python: replace(src, dst) -> None (POSIX-semantics FileRenameInfoEx, fallback MoveFileExW, 2 s retry on winerror 5/32/33), rename_noreplace(src, dst) -> None (FileExistsError if dst exists), unlink(path, *, missing_ok=True) -> None (POSIX delete semantics + retry), rmtree_quietly(path) -> bool (never raises, never follows junctions).

Python: python_child_argv(*args) -> list[str] = [sys.executable, '-E', '-s', '-B', '-X', 'utf8', *args]; python_child_env(base=None) -> dict without PYTHONHOME/PYTHONPATH, with PYTHONUTF8=1, PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1, PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8.
Python: process_identity(pid) -> tuple[int, int] | None (pid, creation FILETIME ticks of a running process via OpenProcess(PROCESS_QUERY_LIMITED_INFORMATION|SYNCHRONIZE)+GetProcessTimes).

Python: stop_event_name(pid=None) -> 'Local\\RadioS-stop-<decimal pid>'; request_stop(pid) -> bool (OpenEventW(EVENT_MODIFY_STATE)+SetEvent; False if no event); class StopRequest (install/close, .event set on request) for SDBASE tool workers.

Python: path_equal(a, b) -> bool (CompareStringOrdinal ignore-case, separator-agnostic), is_inside(root, p) -> bool, is_absolute(p) -> bool, normalize(p) -> str, component_valid(name) -> bool (storage rule 5.5 vectors used by test_storage_locations).
Python: canonical_timezone(name) -> str and check_timezone_database() -> None (fail fast if tzdata missing) for test preflight.

Python tools shim: iter_processes() -> Iterator[ProcessInfo(pid, image_path, argv | None)] via Toolhelp32 + NtQueryInformationProcess(ProcessCommandLineInformation=60) + CommandLineToArgvW; no_proxy_opener() -> urllib OpenerDirector with ProxyHandler({}); configure_stdio_utf8() -> None.

Python testkit (own, ctypes): KillOnCloseJob.adopt_current_process() using CreateJobObjectW + SetInformationJobObject(JobObjectExtendedLimitInformation=9, LimitFlags=0x2000|0x400) + AssignProcessToJobObject(GetCurrentProcess()); has_interactive_desktop() via GetProcessWindowStation + GetUserObjectInformationW(UOI_FLAGS) & WSF_VISIBLE; post_wm_close(pid) via EnumWindows/GetWindowThreadProcessId/PostMessageW(WM_CLOSE); end_session(pid) via SendMessageTimeoutW(WM_QUERYENDSESSION, 0, ENDSESSION_CLOSEAPP) then WM_ENDSESSION(1, ENDSESSION_CLOSEAPP); suppress_error_dialogs() via SetErrorMode(SEM_FAILCRITICALERRORS|SEM_NOGPFAULTERRORBOX|SEM_NOOPENFILEERRORBOX); make_junction(link, target) via _winapi.CreateJunction.

C platform.h (observed by tests): GUI creates manual-reset event Local\RadioS-stop-<pid> and exits 0 when signalled; gui.lock held LOCK_SH on the same 1-byte region (constants RADIOS_LOCK_OFFSET 0x4000000000000000, length 1) through a non-inheritable handle; radios_process_spawn with RADIOS_SPAWN_DETACHED retries without CREATE_BREAKAWAY_FROM_JOB so test jobs can contain the service.

Audio test contract (audio area): RADIOS_AUDIO_SERVER=null:<abs json> (+ RADIOS_TEST_AUDIO_SERVER) schema 1 {running, clock, sinks[{name, description, rate, channels, capture, capture_format f32le|s16le}], sources[{name, tone_hz, amplitude}|{name, file}], applications[{pid, start_time, name, binary, endpoint, tone{hz, amplitude}}], default_sink, default_source}; sink clock real-time from server creation to process exit, appending mixed blocks incl. silence via FILE_APPEND_DATA with share R/W/D; '<sink>.monitor' loopback; JSON rewrite (atomic replace) toggles running/devices; 'none:' = no devices.
